completionCriteria.capacity: Verify the real continuation controller refuses insufficient archive space before claim or custody using disposable fixtures and mocked capacity.
completionCriteria.inert-custody: Add and run an isolated end-to-end test from real run_next(continuation=True) at committed index 8 through existing real Windows Job, inert worker, journal, custody and evidence readback. Reuse the inert shim and lawful fixture technique in tests/al02_release_rehearsal/campaign-controller-probe.py and tests/test_al02_campaign_controller.py. Keep changes within this test module. Adapt command, context and paths only inside the test. Enforce a hard prelaunch barrier that refuses the scientific worker and non-temporary attempts. Carry frozen continuation binding/package identity and committed index/seed separately from synthetic context/seed. Verify terminal custody and analyze with the existing evidence verifier. Do not use production attempt paths or run a World. Do not change frozen artifacts or rerun the completed final batch controller repair.
completionCriteria.inert-reconciliation: After the inert-custody requirement is accepted, extend that fixture with a restart or tampered-journal refusal demonstrating the real controller and custody evidence prevent a new claim or Job launch. Retain the earlier test. Never invoke scientific worker.
completionCriteria.journal-integrity: Extend the already accepted inert continuation fixture to test a distinct gap: tamper only a disposable partial journal after real Windows Job and custody, and verify the real evidence verifier rejects the modified journal against the original terminal pin. Preserve all accepted tests and test-only launch guards; do not run a World or modify production evidence.
completionCriteria.launch-provenance: Exercise the prelaunch no-World barrier of the accepted inert continuation fixture with a substituted command or changed inert shim bytes. Assert refusal before Windows Job or attempt claim. Keep the lawful inert path passing and all existing acceptance intact.
completionCriteria.reviewed-batch-custody: Demonstrate a disposable controller-owned multi-index inert Windows Job and custody run spanning a reviewed batch boundary. Require independently reverified retained evidence and the batch review before the first next-batch claim. Keep committed and synthetic identities separate. Verify one-use, STOP and resource safeguards, and refuse absent or inconsistent review. Preserve the frozen artifacts and scientific no-launch barrier.
